source: 699 Who is to Blame?
target: 699. Cui culpa?

source: The smoke and dust caused by the meteorite had mostly dissipated, and the commotion on the street had gradually subsided.
target: Fumus et pulvis, a meteoro causati, plerumque dissipaverant, et tumultus in platea paulatim cessaverat.

source: The injured had largely escaped danger thanks to swift treatment, but some still perished, eliciting occasional cries of anguish.
target: Vulnerati periculum fere evaserunt celeris medicinae auxilio, sed quidam adhuc perierunt, suscitantes interdum clamores angoris.

source: Inside Saint-Sien Cathedral, Padre Cali completed his penance.
target: In Cathedrali Sancti Sien, Padre Cali poenitentiam perfecit.

source: He stood and turned to face Lumian, who sat silently in the front pew, observing him.
target: Stetit et se vertit ad spectandum Lumianum, qui in primo subsellio tacite sedebat eum observans.

source: Lumian chuckled and asked casually, “Is repentance still of any use?”
target: Lumian subridens atque leviter rogavit: “Num poenitentia adhuc ad aliquid prodest?”

source: Without waiting for a response, he added habitually, “You must know your fate is sealed. You won’t survive more than a few days.”
target: Sine responsum exspectans, more solito addidit: “Scito fatum tuum sigillatum esse. Non superabis plus quam paucos dies.”

source: Paleness showed through Padre Cali’s dark-brown complexion as he calmly replied, “If repentance worked, it wouldn’t be true repentance.”
target: Complexio fusca et obscura Padre Cali pallore illustrata, tranquille respondit: “Si poenitentia operaretur, non vera poenitentia esset.”

source: This statement seemed to bring him a measure of peace.
target: Haec sententia ei modicum pacis attulit.

source: “I repented because I wanted to, not to bargain for understanding or redemption.”
target: “Poenitui quia volui, non ut ad intellegendum aut redimendum mercarer.”

source: “Looking back, I have indeed made many mistakes.”
target: Retrospiciens, revera multa erravi.

source: “I yearned for higher status and the approval of you Northerners.”
target: Superiorem statum et vestra approbationem, Septentrionales, exoptavi.

source: “That desire blinded me, and I succumbed to the Demon’s temptations.”
target: Istud desiderium me caecavit, et daemonis tentationibus succumbi.

source: Lumian scoffed upon hearing this.
target: Lumian hoc audito irridens.

source: “Is that truly the case? Did desire actually cloud your judgment?”
target: “Num vere ita est? Num desiderium iudicium tuum vere obnubilavit?”

source: Noting the padre’s bewildered expression, Lumian leaned back and gazed up at the Sun Sacred Emblem.
target: Animadvertens vultum perplexum Patris, Lumian retrorsum inclinatus sursum ad Solis Sacrum Emblema spectavit.

source: “Did your ambition for prestige and recognition from Northerners force you to collaborate with Twanaku, compel you to become a Wraith as an Eternal Blazing Sun padre, make you receptive to the Demon’s allure, or drive you to exploit those boys? No, you chose this path of your own volition.”
target: “Num ambitio tua de praestantia et agnitione a Septentrionalibus te coegit ut cum Twanaku collaborares, ut Wraith fieres ut Padre Solis Aeterni Flagrantis, ut daemonis allicitati accederes, aut te impulit ut illos iuvenes exploitaris? Non, hoc iter ex tua voluntate elegisti.”

source: Padre Cali’s lips quivered as if to object, but he couldn’t find the words.
target: Labia Padre Cali tremuerunt quasi obiecerent, sed verba invenire non potuit.

source: Lumian smiled and continued, “Many in this world still crave elevated status and the recognition of certain groups.
target: Lumian subridens continuavit: “Multi in hoc mundo adhuc statum elevatum ac agnitionem quibusdam coetuum appetunt.

source: Most of them simply work hard to contribute and combat evil with all their strength.
target: Plurimi strenue laborant ut conferant atque in omni vi malum oppugnent.

source: They never consort with Demons, hoping to attain their goals through righteous means.
target: Numquam cum daemonibus consociantur, sperantes ad metas suas per vias iustas pervenire.

source: Even in the face of repeated failure, they don’t descend into the abyss.
target: Etiam in conspectu cladis iteratae non in abyssum decedunt.

source: They share the same desires, yet they maintain self-control while you could not.
target: Eadem desideria habent, sed se moderant, dum tu non potuisti.

source: Desire didn’t cloud your mind—your mind chose depravity.
target: Desiderium mentem tuam non obnubilos fecit—mens tua pravitatem elegit.

source: Padre Cali fell silent, at a loss for words.
target: Padre Cali tacuit, verbis caret.

source: Lumian sighed with a smile.
target: Lumian cum risu suspiravit.

source: “A relative once told me, ‘Intense desire fuels human progress, but it’s also the demon that drags humans into the abyss. Good or bad, light or darkness—it all hinges on us, on that single thought in a pivotal moment.’”
target: “Quondam cognatus mihi dixit: ‘Intensa cupiditas progressionem humanam alit, sed etiam daemon homines in abyssi trahit. Bene aut male, lux aut tenebrae—omnia in nobis pendent, in illo uno cogitatione, momento decisivo.’”

source: His face growing ever paler, Padre Cali lowered his head and rasped, “I have sinned…”
target: Facies eius magis pallida facta, Padre Cali caput inclinavit et rauco voce exclamat: “Peccavi…”

source: Lumian pressed a hand to his chest, his expression settling.
target: Lumian manum ad pectus apposuit, vultum placide compositum.

source: He looked at Padre Cali and laughed self-deprecatingly.
target: Ad Padre Cali aspexit et seipsum cum modesta humilitate risit.

source: “I too have strong desires.
target: “Etiam ego vehementa desideria habeo.

source: Everyone does.
target: Omnes habent.

source: If harboring intense desire is a sin, then you are a sinner, and so am I.
target: Si vehementum desiderium colere peccatum est, tunc tu peccator es, et ego quoque.

source: We are all guilty.
target: Omnes culpabiles sumus.

source: Padre Cali’s expression froze momentarily before he slowly turned around.
target: Vultus Padre Cali momento congelatus est, antequam lente se converteret.

source: Kneeling once more before the altar, he gazed up at the immense Sun Sacred Emblem and spoke in a deep voice, “You are innocent. Desire itself is not sinful, but I am a true sinner.”
target: Iterum ad altare genu flectens, sursum intuebatur ingentem Emblema Sacrum Solis, et voce profunda dixit, “Innocens es. Ipse desiderium non est peccatum, sed ego vere peccator sum.”

source: He bowed his head as his body gradually became ethereal and transparent.
target: Caput inclinavit, dum corpus eius paulatim aethereum et perspicuum fieret.

source: Thus, Padre Cali manifested as a Wraith before the Sacred Emblem.
target: Ita, Padre Cali se manifestavit ut umbra ante Emblema Sacrum.

source: An icy, sinister aura emanated from him, triggering a reaction from the emblem and altar.
target: Gelida et sinistra aura ex eo emanabat, provocans reactionem ab emblema et altare.

source: The entire cathedral trembled slightly.
target: Tota cathedrale leviter tremuit.

source: A brilliant, sunlight-like radiance seeped from the altar, emblem, stained glass, and religious murals, rapidly converging at the domed ceiling.
target: Splendida radiatio, instar solis fulgoris, ex altare, emblema, vitreis pictis, et muralibus sacris effulgebat, celeriter in tecto cupola conveniens.

source: A dazzling golden pillar of light, accompanied by a hymnal voice, descended upon Padre Cali.
target: Columna aurea lucis stupenda, comitata voce hymnica, in Padre Cali descendit.

source: The Wraith-form padre trembled faintly but did not evade.
target: Padre in forma umbrae parum tremuit, sed non evasit.

source: Under the searing holy light, his body disintegrated into ashes.
target: Sub luce sacra ardenti, corpus eius in cinerem disintegratum est.

source: Lumian observed this scene expressionlessly, feeling neither joy nor sorrow.
target: Lumian hanc scenam, nec gaudium nec dolorem sentiens, impassibiliter contemplatus est.

source: As the dome’s holy glow dissipated, leaving only candlelight illuminating the cathedral, Lumian remained seated in the front pew, quietly contemplating the spot where Padre Cali had been purified.
target: Dum splendor sacer cupolae evanuit, relinquens solum lumen candelarum quae cathedralem illuminabat, Lumian in primo subsellio sedebat, quiete meditans locum quo Padre Cali purgatus erat.

source: After an indeterminate span, Camus and Rhea entered the cathedral, having finished their disaster relief efforts.
target: Post tempore incertum, Camus et Rhea in cathedrale intraverunt, opus subsidii calamitatum confecitantes.

source: Camus sighed in relief upon seeing Louis Berry in the front row.
target: Camus leviter suspiravit ex solacio, cum Louis Berry in prima ordine appareret.

source: He smiled and said, “We still lack composure, prone to panic when calamity strikes.”
target: Subridens dixit: “Nondum compositi sumus, ad pavorem in calamitatibus inclini soletis.”

source: We were so focused on aiding the injured and trapped that we never anticipated a detestable man like Padre Cali suddenly going mad and trying to drag others down with him.
target: Tam occupati ad vulneratos et captivos adiuvandos fuimus, ut numquam exspectaremus virum abominabilem, ut Padre Cali, subitamente insanire et alios secum in ruinas trahere conari.

source: It’s fortunate you were here.
target: Felix est quod hic adfuisti.

source: Rhea surveyed the surroundings and asked, “Where is Padre Cali?”
target: Rhea circumstantia aspexit atque quaesivit: “Ubi est Padre Cali?”

source: Lumian stared ahead at the altar and replied plainly, “After repenting, he utilized the cathedral’s accumulated spirituality and the Sacred Emblem’s unique properties to purify himself.”
target: Lumian ad altare aspexit et perspicue respondit: “Post poenitentiam, spiritualitatem cathedralis congregatam et proprietates unicas Emblema Sacrum ad se purgandum usus est.”

source: Rhea fell silent. After a few seconds, she spread her arms and proclaimed, “Praise the Sun!”
target: Rhea silentium obtinuit. Pauculis secundis, brachia extendens proclamavit: “Laudate Solem!”

source: She then took a seat in the front pew on the opposite side, clasped her hands, bowed her head, and prayed fervently.
target: Deinde in primo subsellio latere opposito consedit, manus conplectens, caput inclinavit, et ferventer oravit.

source: For a moment, Camus was unsure whether to sit or remain standing.
target: Per momentum, Camus dubitavit utrum sedere an stans manere debeat.

source: Lumian turned to him. “Have you recovered Reaza’s Beyonder characteristic?”
target: Lumian ad eum conversus dixit: “Recuperavistine indolem Beyonder de Reaza?”

source: Camus paused before responding, “Yes.”
target: Camus ante responsum pausavit: “Ita.”

source: “And Maslow’s?” Lumian shifted his gaze back to the Sacred Emblem.
target: “Et Maslow?” Lumian oculos iterum ad Emblema Sacrum convertebat.

source: “Its whereabouts are unknown,” Camus replied.
target: “Ubi sit, ignotum est,” respondit Camus.

source: Lumian stated calmly, “It should be in the meteorite impact zone.”
target: Lumian tranquille dixit: “Existimatur eo esse in regione impactionis meteoriti.”

source: Camus was taken aback.
target: Camus obstupuit.

source: “Was the meteorite meant to claim most of the deceased? Is the Dream Festival’s power truly that immense?”
target: “Num meteorītum destinatum erat ut plerosque defunctos interficeret? Num vis Festivali Somniorum vere tam ingens est?”

source: “More potent than you realize,” Lumian replied, as if discussing the next day’s weather.
target: “Potentior quam putatis,” respondit Lumian, quasi de caelo crastino dicens.

source: “Reaza and Maslow belong to the Numinous Episcopate’s Royal faction. Admiral Querarill is aware of their identities and that Reaza came to Tizamo to fulfill a mission assigned by the Royal faction’s superiors.”
target: “Reaza et Maslow factioni regiae Episcopatus Numinous pertinent. Admiral Querarill identitates eorum novit atque quod Reaza ad Tizamo venit ad missionem ex factionis regiae superioribus mandatam explendam.”

source: Camus’s expression shifted as he exhaled slowly.
target: Vultus Camus mutatus est, dum lente exhalabat.

source: “Even without you mentioning this, I wouldn’t have harbored any ill will towards Captain Reaza.”
target: “Etiam, nisi hoc diceres, adversus Capitanum Reaza nullo animo malum tenerem.”

source: He did save me on multiple occasions, and this time, he didn’t overtly betray me but rather the patrol team.
target: Me pluries servavit, et hoc tempore non me palam prodidit, sed manipulum speculatorum.

source: My sense of belonging to the team isn’t that strong.
target: Sensus meus pertinendi ad manipulum non tam fortis est.

source: Now, I’m just relieved he’s not a traitor.
target: Nunc solum me levatum existimo quod non sit proditor.

source: Lumian smiled provocatively and said, “It benefits you as well. Port Pylos’s patrol team now has a vacant vice-captain position, and your rival is already dead.”
target: Lumian provocanter subridens dixit: “Hoc tibi quoque prodest. Manipulus praesidii Port Pylos nunc locum vice-capitanei vacuum habet, et adversarius tuus iam mortuus est.”

source: Camus didn’t rise to the bait, smiling wryly instead.
target: Camus ad instigationem non accessit, sed potius sardonice subridens manebat.

source: “I plan to leave Matani.”
target: “Cogito Matani relinquere.”

source: “Thanks to your generosity, I’ve nearly saved enough to advance to Sequence 6. It’s safer and simpler to return to my family and contact the main branch than to search the outside world.
target: “Propter tuam largitatem, fere satis servavi ut ad Sequenciam VI progrediar. Tutior et facilior est familiam redire et ramum principale contingere, quam extra orbem quaerere.”

source: “The patrol team is a small organization, after all. Sequence 6 is the limit. To reach Sequence 5, I’d need to forge close ties with the Numinous Episcopate, Rose School of Thought, Intis Bureau 8, the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, or the Church of Earth Mother, or become Admiral Querarill’s trusted aide. Given my Castiya surname, the choice is clear.”
target: “Manipulus praesidii, denique, parvus est. Sequencia VI est finis. Ad Sequenciam V pervenire, necesse est mihi vincula intima constituere cum Episcopato Numinous, Schola Rosae Cogitationis, Bureau Intis VIII, Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Flagrantis, aut Ecclesia Matris Terrae, aut firi adiutor fidus Admiralium Querarill. Cum cognomine Castiya meo, electio manifesta est.”

source: If the Castiya royal family truly accepts you, your potential would be far greater…
target: Si familia regia Castiya te vere accipit, potentia tua longe maior foret…

source: Lumian chuckled and said, “I thought you were leaving this place of sorrow due to a failed romance.”
target: Lumian subridentem dixit: “Putabam te hunc lugubrem locum relinquere ob relationem fallacem.”

source: Camus abruptly choked on his saliva and coughed several times.
target: Camus subito saliva suae obstrictus est et pluries tussivit.

source: After Rhea concluded her prayers, she departed the cathedral with Camus.
target: Postquam Rhea preces finivit, cathedrale cum Camus discessit.

source: Lumian lingered in the front pew, savoring the solitude.
target: Lumian in primo subsellio manebat, solitudinem fruens.

source: After a while, Amandina appeared at the entrance, clad in black hunting attire.
target: Post aliquod tempus, Amandina ad ostium apparuit, vestimenta venatoria atra induta.

source: “Why are you alone here?” the girl muttered, her gaze darting about as if searching for something.
target: “Quare sola hic ades?” puella submurmuravit, oculos circumfugientes quasi aliquid quaereret.

source: “Why have you come?” Lumian asked nonchalantly.
target: “Cur venisti?” Lumian leviter rogavit.

source: Amandina sat beside him and chuckled.
target: Amandina iuxta eum consedit et subridens.

source: “I wanted to see if Robert would come looking for the dying Padre Cali, but surprisingly, you’re the only one here.”
target: “Volebam videre num Robertus ad moribundum Padre Cali quaerendum veniret, sed mirum, solus hic es.”

source: “Padre Cali purified himself. I doubt Robert has been here,” Lumian answered truthfully.
target: “Padre Cali se purgavit. Dubito Robertum hic fuisse,” Lumian veraciter respondit.

source: “Is that so…” Amandina felt a pang of disappointment. “If he had really come to confront Padre Cali, it would mean he still is a man…”
target: “Sic est…” Amandina levem tristitiam sensit. “Si revera ad Padre Cali opponendum venisset, id significaret eum adhuc virum esse…”

source: Lumian remained silent.
target: Lumian tacuit.

source: Amandina faced the altar and Sacred Emblem, offering a brief prayer.
target: Amandina ad altare et Emblema Sacrum se convertit, brevem precem offerens.

source: Her task complete, she glanced around eagerly and asked, “Will there be another Dream Festival next year?”
target: Res completa, circumspiciens aviditer, quaesivit: “Num alius Festival Somniorum anno proximo fiet?”

source: “Yes.” Lumian didn’t hide anything.
target: “Ita.” Lumian nihil celavit.

source: Joy instantly lit up Amandina’s features.
target: Gaudium statim vultum Amandinae illustravit.

source: “Is that black ancient tomb still there? Can I gain superpowers by touching it again?”
target: “Num illud sepulcrum antiquum atrum adhuc ibi est? Possumne iterum eo tangendo potentias supernas adipisci?”

source: “Of course,” Lumian turned to her, smiling. “But the outsiders participating in next year’s Dream Festival will be even stronger and more terrifying, surpassing the evil cloth doll, crystal skull, and human skin man you encountered.”
target: “Certe,” Lumian ad eam se convertit, subridens, “sed externos qui in Festivalo Somniorum anni proximo participant, robustiores ac terribiles erunt, superantes malam pupam pannosam, cranium crystallinum, et hominem cutis humanae quem occurristi.”

source: Amandina’s expression fell.
target: Vultus Amandinae deiectus est.

source: “Really? In that case, I’ll find an excuse to stay in Port Pylos during next year’s festival and bring my parents along.”
target: “Vere? Ergo, in Festivalo anni proximo in Portu Pylos manere mihi excusationem inveniam et parentes meos secum ducabo.”

source: “Have you returned to Palm Manor?” Lumian inquired.
target: “Num rediisti ad Palmam Maneriam?” inquit Lumian.

source: Amandina sighed and smiled.
target: Amandina suspiravit et subridit.

source: “I went back briefly. Not wanting to disrupt their facade of love, I left again.”
target: “Breviter redii. Nolens eorum speciem amoris perturbare, iterum discessi.”

source: She paused, eyes sparkling with curiosity.
target: Stetit, oculis cum curiositate fulgentibus.

source: “Besides touching the black tomb, are there other ways for me to advance my Sequence?”
target: “Praeter tangendum sepulcrum atrum, num aliae viae sunt quo meam Sequenciam progredi possim?”

source: “You can buy formulas and drink potions to progress along one of three paths—Sleepless, Corpse Collector, or Warrior,” Lumian divulged the relevant mystical knowledge without reservation.
target: “Formulae emere potes et potionibus bibere ut in unam trium semitarum iter progrediaris—Insomnes, Collectorem Cadaverum, aut Bellatorem,” Lumian sine mora scientiam mysticam revelavit.

source: After some thought, he added, “Also, it wasn’t the black tomb that granted you superpowers. It was that figure…”
target: Postquam paulum cogitavit, addidit: “Praeterea, non sepulcrum atrum tibi potentias supernas concessit; illa figura fuit…”

source: Lumian was suddenly perplexed.
target: Lumian subito perplexus est.

source: What was the connection between Amandina, Robert, and the Underworld Daoist?
target: Quae erat relatio inter Amandinam, Robertum, et Daoistam Inferorum?

source: Typically, boons were bestowed upon believers by deities or angels, but Amandina and Robert had no faith in the Underworld Daoist. They weren’t even aware of His existence.
target: Saepe dona a deis vel angelis credentibus largiebantur, sed Amandina et Robertus in Daoista Inferorum nullam fidem habebant. Ne eius quidem existentiam agnoverant.

source: Considering the conventions of various secret organizations and the customs Franca occasionally mentioned, Amandina should have addressed the Underworld Daoist as “Teacher”!
target: Consideratis regulis variorum consociationum secretarum et moribus quos Franca interdum commemoravit, Amandina Daoistam Inferorum “Magistro” appellare debuit!
